mentions.name: Google SEO black box investigation
mentions.description: This project investigates how Google's SEO ranking 'black box' works, with a focus on the new anti-AI/slop article filters that went live March 6th and took down many legitimate websites.
mentions.problem: Google's new anti-AI/slop article filters (live March 6th) penalized a bunch of legitimate websites, and SEO ranking operates as an opaque black box.
mentions.source_excerpt: Figuring out how the google SEO black box works especially after the new anti-ai / slop articles filters went live March 6th taking a bunch of legitimate websites with it.

evidence.value: Figuring out how the google SEO black box works especially after the new anti-ai / slop articles filters went live March 6th taking a bunch of legitimate websites with it.
